title: DignoX
description: An AI-powered medical document analysis platform that reads, understands, and extracts structured data from complex medical PDFs.
challenge: Medical administrators were spending hours manually reading and transcribing data from patient reports, lab results, and insurance forms. Accuracy was inconsistent.
solution: Built a FastAPI backend with OpenAI GPT-4 vision for document understanding, structured extraction into typed schemas, and a React frontend for upload and review. Achieved 94% extraction accuracy on test documents.
